description.value: Fernie Brewing Company is a craft brewery and tasting room nestled just off Highway 3 at the eastern edge of Fernie, in the Kootenay Rockies, offering pints, flights, growlers, and cold packaged beer to go. The brewery runs 'Trail to Ale,' an event pairing local trail adventures with craft beer, reflecting its deep roots in the Elk Valley outdoor culture. A non-alcoholic line (LOGO™) and gluten-free options are always available, making it a welcoming stop for a wide range of cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active craft brewery tasting room at 26 Manitou Rd., Fernie, open 7 days a week. The FAQ page provides explicit evidence for washrooms ('accessible washroom'), gluten-free options, and no kitchen (only bar snacks), and the storefront/contact pages confirm beer-to-go and packaged product as takeout. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both are present on the website (26 Manitou Rd., Fernie, BC V0B 1M5; 250-423-7797 / 1-855-777-2739) and should be added to OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible craft brewery tasting room and retail store open 7 days a week; a natural stop for touring cyclists on a Kootenay route.

Packed lunches.detail: FAQ states: 'We don't have a kitchen, but we do have bar snacks, such as jerky and chips.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'We always have a gluten-free option available and we also have our own non-alc line LOGO™ by FBC.'

wow_evidence: Trail to Ale, an event pairing local trail adventures with craft beer
